# Recorded native arc inner-evidence fixtures

These unchanged operation and response bytes come from the independently
qualified result-3 service radius5/7 example at the ce5b50b baseline. The
provenance manifest records exact source identity and file SHA-256 values.
Both genuine solve/replay cases use the pinned CPython 3.12, slvs 3.2 and OCCT
8.0.1.1.0 environment; no native execution is performed by these unit tests.

Historical backend receipts are preserved for provenance only. They are not
fresh process, lifetime, owner or publication authority. Portable unit tests
validate the unchanged inner response, then use an explicitly synthetic outer
receipt test port to exercise exact guarded binding and conservative sink
rejection. That test port makes no claim about a new native process identity.
Data-only dictionaries, including these files, cannot authorize live sinks.
